notes:
Lead source: inbound — developer sign-up from product hunt link. Team: 6 engineers, CTO Alan Vega, lead frontend dev Priya Singh. Primary product: in-app chat widget embedded in SaaS dashboard (B2B CRM integrations).

Technical priorities: low latency (aim <=200ms per user message end-to-end), streaming responses for perceived snappiness, ability to stream partial tokens to client, support for prefix/KV caching for repeat user flows. Prototype used a medium-sized open model; looking for lower per-token unit cost without sacrificing latency.

Security/compliance: need SSO for admin console (SAML/Okta), audit logs for admin actions, basic data retention controls (30/90/365 day retention options). Customer is comfortable with public cloud hosting but wants EU residency for some customers (GDPR note).

Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18: "Feels snappy in prototype but token costs will balloon if we don't optimize batching and cache. Show me the SLOs and what happens under burst load."

Product asks / POC success criteria: 1) steady-state p95 latency <=200ms for 32 char prompts, 2) streaming SDK that drops into their React widget with minimal glue code, 3) clear unit economics for 50k monthly messages, 4) simple rollout plan with canary and fallback to smaller cheaper model on overload.

Sales notes: Warm, engineering-first conversation. Prefers docs + code samples over slides. Price sensitivity high — wants predictable monthly bill rather than open-ended per-token surprises. Discuss dedicated later if ARR justifies.

Next actions: Send example streaming SDK snippet (React) + Hosted API sample with streaming SSE/ws, include recommended batching config for chat, and a cost estimate for 50k messages/month. Schedule 30m SE demo week of Mar 15.
